admission.justification: Prevents selection changes arriving during cold-load readiness waits from triggering premature or destructive fallback reloads while keeping late ready recovery intact.

applicability: Selection changes during the readiness wait started by a document load.
conditions: Only the latest requested selection is retained.
Ready or pong restores a supported message channel and sends the held selection by message.
Unanswered post-load ping or cold-load cap expiry settles unavailable without destroying the in-flight frame.
exclusions: An explicitly unsupported-open plugin remains URL-only.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "holds a change made right after that load for the loaded document's ready report, and loads again only on another unanswered ping"; red on the bytes of Attempt2: notes/reports/worker/c41a5d77-92e0-4b18-a3d6-140c0a7e0b50/after-evidence-attempt3/red/dashboard-red.txt

statement: A change of the selection made while a load's ready report is still awaited is held: it goes out by message at ready or pong, and if the post-load ping stays unanswered or the 45 s cold-load cap expires, control settles unavailable without reloading the in-flight frame while late ready or explicit Retry can still recover it.
title: Selections during load readiness wait are held for ready without reload
